summary: Retested the visualizer fix from iteration_10. ALL checks PASS. The useEffect dep change from [] to [loading] correctly causes the effect to re-run once the spinner is replaced and the <canvas> mounts. Canvas internal dims are now 520x300 (proves the effect ran), and getImageData reports 77,591 / 156,000 non-transparent pixels (vs 0 / 45,000 before). Layering preserved (canvas z-index 1 behind album-art z-index 10, bounds overlap). Playback advances normally and zero console/page errors. Screenshot confirms the glowing purple+gold waves are now visible behind and around the album art, matching the home-screen aesthetic.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correct: switching useEffect deps from [] to [loading] schedules the effect after the spinner is replaced by the canvas; the !canvas guard remains as a safety net.
Consider a callback ref (ref={node => node && start(node)}) as a more future-proof pattern that doesn't depend on `loading` state — but not required for this bug.
Idle-amplitude boost (base 0.6) is good — guarantees waves render in environments with no audio energy (headless/CORS-blocked source).
seed_data_creation: No new seed data — reused the 3 existing test stations from prior iterations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Visualizer bug from iter10 is FULLY RESOLVED. Canvas now renders animated purple+gold waves behind the album art on the now-playing screen. No regressions in playback, layering, or console. Stations are persisted in DB so future tests can skip station creation and click an existing station card directly.

rca_of_the_issue.bug: Visualizer canvas behind album art rendered nothing (0 pixels drawn).
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Player.jsx visualizer useEffect had [] deps — fired once on initial mount while `loading=true` early-returned a spinner, so canvasRef.current was null and the effect's !canvas guard caused silent exit. The effect never re-ran after the canvas finally mounted.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied_by_main_agent: Changed useEffect deps from [] to [loading] in Player.jsx so the effect re-runs once loading flips false and the <canvas> is in the DOM.
rca_of_the_issue.verification: Canvas.width===520, canvas.height===300, 77591/156000 alpha>0 pixels, screenshot shows glowing purple+gold waves around album art.
